name: The Ruins of Solarsal
summary: South of Shandris Feathermoon, Hatecrest naga crowd the Ruins of Solarsal. She sends you among the old stones to look for anything out of the ordinary.

sections.title: Naga in the Old Stones
sections.body: Shandris Feathermoon says explorers searched the ruins long ago and found nothing of note. So the stones were left alone. Now Hatecrest naga have taken them in alarming numbers. Their presence first seemed to herald an attack, and that danger remains. Yet Shandris suspects something else may be happening. She asks you to walk through the ruins and notice anything out of the ordinary.

sections.title: What Stands Out
sections.body: A gazebo differs from the surrounding stonework and is plainly newer. Small glyphs repeat along its sides, though no one knows where they came from or what they mean. The stone is warm to the touch.

faq.q: Where are the Ruins of Solarsal?
faq.answer: The ruins lie south of Shandris Feathermoon.

faq.q: Why is Shandris Feathermoon concerned about the ruins?
faq.answer: Hatecrest naga have occupied the ruins in alarming numbers. Their presence first seemed like preparation for an attack, and that remains possible. Shandris suspects something else may be happening.

faq.q: What were the Ruins of Solarsal before the naga arrived?
faq.answer: The ruins pre-date modern times. Shandris says they were explored long ago, but nothing of note was found, so they were left alone.

faq.q: Which naga are in the ruins?
faq.answer: Hatecrest naga are in the ruins.
